moonrelay_scope: Unreleased 0.5.0 development snapshot; not v0.4.0 or the latest local candidate
completion: tool-native completion plus independently checked payload paths/SHA-256; no common durability wrapper
rclone_transport: SFTP over external OpenSSH; not native Go SSH and not rclone default UX
scheduling: Interleaved randomized configurations; original block positions are retained. All fixed observations of each displayed build/tool are included.
limitations: Single host pair and sequential time windows, warm source and SSH, shared background load; not a universal ranking.
Independent complete SHA-256 and file-set verification is timed separately; native durability semantics differ.
Interruption at 32 MiB observed encrypted SSH stream, 8 MiB/s cap, client process group termination and payload disconnect; actual persisted prefixes can differ.
Restart timings include only the restarted command plus final verification.
SSH counters exclude TCP/IP framing and TCP retransmission; storage totals are unique-inode observations, not peak or reflink-aware physical use.
